d: Is China facing another copycat car controversy? India's Tata Motors-owned Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) is taking on Chinese automaker BYD over its Ti7 SUV, which looks strikingly similar to the iconic Land Rover Defender. JLR suspects BYD may have copied not just the design but also some of its technology. The legal battle has brought back memories of earlier disputes involving Chinese cars that resembled models from BMW, Mini and Porsche. But why was copying so difficult to stop in China? And can JLR prove that BYD crossed the line?
